lists.seen_20260905_test: test cases whose statements were viewed in the 2026-09-05 reference spot check (id sets, exclusions); dropped from the main and the other sensitivity sets, included only in the *_incl0905 sets
lists.nl_not_linearizable: IndustryOR cases whose adjudicated type label is NL_NOT_LINEARIZABLE (data/exclusions_r1.json); kept, reported separately, not in main and not in the MDE sample size
lists.q3_removed: sampled reference checks with verdict AMBIGUOUS or UNDERSPECIFIED (data/exclusions_r1.json); out of the main set, kept in the full-data sensitivity sets and scored with the original reference
lists.underspecified_screen: keyword under-specification screen data/mamo_underspecified_ids.json (rule mamo_underspec_keyword.v1); only for the well-specified secondary subset

reference_kinds.r1: reference values after data/reference_overrides/ (CORRECT_ROUNDED and INCORRECT replaced; the original value is reported alongside)
reference_kinds.original: the benchmark reference values as frozen in data/cases/
reference_kinds.not_a_signal: cases looked at for error types only; their correctness is not used as a signal

main.role: primary analysis: MAMO cleaned subset + IndustryOR 2026 revision, without the 2026-09-05-viewed cases, the NL_NOT_LINEARIZABLE cases and the Q3-removed cases

sens_orig_ref.role: sensitivity: the main cases scored with the original reference values

sens_full211.role: data-version sensitivity: all 211 MAMO cases (full pinned version) + all IndustryOR cases; Q3-removed cases kept (they have no override, so they are scored with the original reference); 2026-09-05-viewed and NL_NOT_LINEARIZABLE cases still out

sens_incl0905.role: sensitivity: the main set with the 2026-09-05-viewed cases added back (MAMO cleaned subset 1, IndustryOR 4); the only result that includes them

sens_full211_incl0905.role: sensitivity: sens_full211 with the 2026-09-05-viewed cases added back (MAMO 5, IndustryOR 4)

well_specified.role: secondary: main without the cases hit by the keyword under-specification screen

nl_separate.role: IndustryOR NL_NOT_LINEARIZABLE cases, reported separately (not in main, not in the MDE sample size)

dev_signal55.role: dev correctness signal for gene iteration and checkpoint diagnostics: MAMO cleaned dev 30 + IndustryOR dev 25

dev_all85.role: all dev cases (pipeline checks); correctness is a signal only on dev_signal55

dev_error_type_only30.role: the 30 MAMO dev cases removed by the cleaning: error types only, never a correctness signal
